column1: # Requirements for Mica::Regex milestones R1 (the Crystal-dialect front end)
# and R2 (the Pike VM, the bounded backtracker and the native search API):
# the PCRE2 10.49 pattern syntax subset it accepts, the constructs it
# refuses by name, its compile limits and allocation ledger, Unicode tables
# and case folding, and the complexity of compiling. The PCRE2 testinput
# census (spec/regex/pcre2_syntax_census_spec.cr) covers the grammar case by
# case; this catalog traces the behaviors the specs pin down.

column3: Literals, escapes (\a \e \f \n \r \t \xhh \x{} \o{} \0 octal \cX \N{U+}) and \Q...\E quoting read as PCRE2 reads them
Bracketed classes, ranges, negation, POSIX classes and class escapes follow PCRE2's class rules
\p and \P accept PCRE2's loose property names (general categories, scripts, script extensions, Bidi classes, Boolean properties, Any, L&, Xan, Xps, Xsp, Xwd, Xuc)
*, +, ?, {n}, {n,}, {n,m}, {,m} with lazy suffix; a quantifier with nothing to repeat is an error
Capturing, named, non-capturing and branch-reset groups number captures as PCRE2 does
Inline option settings (?imnrsxxJUa-...) and start-of-pattern settings apply with PCRE2's scoping
Backreferences, lookaround, atomic and possessive forms, recursion, conditionals, callouts, verbs, \K, \C and \X raise UnsupportedConstructError naming the construct and its byte offset
Malformed patterns raise SyntaxError with the byte offset PCRE2 reports
Pattern bytes, nesting depth, captures, class ranges, program states and compile bytes are refused with CompileLimitError naming the limit
The size preflight bounds program states with saturating arithmetic before Hir is built
Every compile allocation is charged to the ledger before it is made, and compiling stays under max_compile_bytes
Unicode 17.0.0 tables are generated from the sha256-pinned UCD and match PCRE2 10.49's property names
Case-insensitive classes close over simple case folding per dialect; (?r) keeps ASCII and non-ASCII apart
Code point ranges split into exact UTF-8 byte-range sequences, surrogates excluded
Patterns translate to Hir with folded classes, explicit repetition counts and captures only
Every PCRE2 10.49 testinput pattern is classified; Mica and PCRE2 agree on acceptance except for listed exclusions and divergences
Compile work grows linearly with pattern size, and the roadmap 6.8 families are refused under max_compile_bytes
Random and mutated patterns end in a result or a Mica::Error, never a crash
Hir compiles to a byte-level Thompson NFA with UTF-8 automata, within the preflight bound, checking max_program_states while emitting and max_pike_bytes when done
Searches report the leftmost-first match with PCRE2's meanings: an empty group iteration ends the repetition, \R is atomic, anchors and word boundaries follow the Crystal dialect
Expression and MatchData mirror Regex and Regex::MatchData (match, match!, match_at_byte_index, matches?, captures, named groups, name table, escape, union)
each_match, scan, gsub, sub and split follow String#scan, #gsub, #sub and #split, with one work allowance per call
Every search takes required SearchLimits; running out of work or output raises SearchLimitError naming the limit, and a timeout raises DeadlineExceededError
The RE2 search tests and the Rust regex tests pass under fixed denominators, every eligible case on every engine path
